description: This file defines the ResourceNode class, an implementation of PolicyTreeNode for resource nodes within a permission and policy management system. It includes methods for managing child nodes, permissions, and generating JSON pointers for resource identification.

classes.name: ResourceNode
classes.description: A class representing resource nodes in a policy tree, managing permissions, children, and resource identification via JSON pointers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create ResourceNode instances with or without specified permissions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the resource node.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the node, which is RESOURCE.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves a child node by resource name.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing the node.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent node, if any.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the permissions associated with this node.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Sets the permissions for this node.

methods.name: isGranted
methods.description: Checks if a specific permission (and optionally additional permissions) are granted and not revoked.

methods.name: areAllGranted
methods.description: Checks if all specified permissions are granted and none are revoked.

methods.name: areAllRevoked
methods.description: Checks if all specified permissions are revoked.

methods.name: getAbsolutePointer
methods.description: Computes and returns the JSON pointer representing the resource node's absolute path.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the depth level of the node within the resource tree.
